text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A journey filled with boisterous bickering alongside Inari One—
those three years spent walking together
had finally come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, her journey as an Umamusume
is still far from over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that will surely ignite another festival that rouses the hearts of the people once more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Inari One, taking Oguri Cap
and Super Creek along with us, to visit Oi Racecourse and Inari's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That was a truly wonderful race~♪
It was so powerful, it had me on the edge of my seat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Everyone's raring to go today too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of my days running at Kasamatsu.
...For some reason, it makes me want to
race on dirt again.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good!
Wanna go for a round when we get back?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big Sis Inari~!
So you did come—wait, HUH!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, isn't that Oguri Cap-san
and Super Creek-san?!
All of the "Eternal Big Three" are gathered here~!!

text_block_list.name: Bystanders
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez, this guy!
What the heck are you saying, you blockhead!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Inari-chan!
Are you with your friends from the academy today?
Make sure to stop by my shop later, okay!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... That smells delicious.
A soba shop, is it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This place is my regular hangout.
The shrimp tempura in particular is the absolute best in the world!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We simply must eat that, then~♪
I'm getting pretty hungry anyway.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan!
We'll give you a discount at our shop too!
Why don't you come drop by?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, that's a welcome offer! After all, Tracen Academy's proud, number-one big eater is right here with us today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For starters,
I want to eat at every single shop in this shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text: Th-This is a real bad vibe...! Go call every young lad around! The whole shopping district is going to war over this!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Inari. Thank you for today.
It was so much fun, and the food was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, glad to hear that.
Everyone said to "come back again," so
let's visit them again when we get the chance.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, by all means.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And also... would you like to visit Kasamatsu next time?
I'd like to introduce everyone in Kasamatsu
to Inari and the others too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds awesome!
I want Oguri to show me around her hometown too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's definitely go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—Inari-chan.
Thank you so much for today♪
I had a wonderful time as well~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Spending today with you has
made me realize something clearly."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What did I learn, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan's strength and kindness...
The source of that power comes from
the place where she grew up, doesn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, I'm a chic Umamusume
born and raised in the downtown shitamachi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Trainer's Room, after parting ways
with Oguri Cap and the others—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Boss.
About what Creek said earlier—"
choice_data_list: So where you grew up is the source of your strength, Inari?
So where you grew up is the source of your strength, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Boss Lady.
About what Creek said earlier—"
choice_data_list: So where you grew up is the source of your strength, Inari?
So where you grew up is the source of your strength, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...You're technically right, yeah.
'Cept your answer's missin' a little somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's true, everyone downtown
is a vital source of strength for me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: However, just as much as that—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're the source of my strength, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Big Sis is the source of my strength.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's been that way, and from here on out...
that's never gonna change.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you from now on too, partner.
